seo.title: IEEE EMBS at UCF
seo.description: The IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society chapter at the University of Central Florida. Speakers, workshops, hardware teams, and student membership of the world's largest biomedical engineering society.

hero.eyebrow: IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society
hero.headline: Biomedical engineering
hero.lede: IEEE EMBS is the largest biomedical engineering society in the world, and this is its chapter at the University of Central Florida. We run speakers, workshops, and a small number of hardware teams.

workSection.heading: What some members are building
workSection.lede: A couple of build teams run alongside everything else. They are one of the things the chapter offers rather than the whole of it, and they take new people at any point.

pillarSection.heading: Meetings, workshops, and a society behind them
pillarSection.lede: A fair description of what you would be signing up for.

pillars.title: General body meetings
pillars.body: The main thing the chapter does. Updates, a speaker or a hands-on segment, and time afterwards to talk to people who are further along than you are.

pillars.title: Workshops and build teams
pillars.body: Skill sessions — soldering, instrumentation, signal processing — and a small number of hardware teams for people who want to spend their time that way.

pillars.title: IEEE EMBS membership
pillars.body: EMBS is the largest biomedical engineering society in the world. Society membership opens scholarships, member conference rates, and the journals — none of which the chapter can hand out on its own.

joinSection.heading: Three steps, none of them difficult

steps.title: Come to a general body meeting
steps.body: They are on the chapter calendar. Turn up — there is no signup form and nobody will stop you at the door.

steps.title: Pick up whatever interests you
steps.body: Workshops, a speaker series, outreach, or one of the build teams. Most members do some of these and not others.

steps.title: Join IEEE EMBS
steps.body: Society membership is the step that unlocks scholarships, conference rates, and journal access. It is cheapest while you are a student.

closing.heading: Come to one meeting before you decide.
closing.body: That is genuinely the entire ask. Check the calendar, find the next general body meeting, and see whether it is for you.
